mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 47 degrees with clear skies near the Public Library. We have a lovely Waning Gibbous moon tonight, and you can catch the International Space Station passing over for 6 minutes starting at 5:03 PM, appearing in the northwest near Verona High School and traveling toward the east over Fitchburg.

The City of Verona has announced that candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election are available, with a January 5 filing deadline. Additionally, residents are reminded that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15.

There is plenty to do around town, starting with the Crafty Fair today at ART House 360 and live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, we have yoga on Sunday and various trivia nights next week including Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.
In a report from November 11, a 54-year-old Verona woman was taken into custody for bail jumping after flagging down officers for a situation that was not actually occurring.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. The restaurant is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM, so stop by Verona's Culver's today to grab a treat.
